title: The Episode About the Hill chief of Mandi

blocks.text: An anecdote about a mantra-book and fulfilled desire leads into the problem of the Jajowal or Jaswal ruler’s childlessness, pushing the narrative toward Banda’s household and blessing rather than immediate war.
Court women hear of a woman associated with Banda whose speech does not fail, and they begin seeking access to that source of grace.
Jajowal is the anchor because the page moves through local dynasty anxiety and the search for offspring under Banda’s shadow.
